title: Settings

privacy.shareCheckInsDesc: Your assigned coach can see your daily check-ins and tracker entries. You can turn this off at any time.
privacy.updateErrorBody: We couldn't save that privacy change. Your previous setting is still active. Please try again.

notifications.dailyNudgeBody: How are you doing today? Take a moment to check in.
dailyNudgeBodies: How are you doing today? Take a moment to check in.
A quick check-in keeps your streak — and your clarity — going.
90 seconds for yourself. How's your heart today?
You showed up yesterday. Show up for you again today.
Notice how you're feeling before the day takes over.
One small moment of honesty with yourself. Ready?
Your check-in is waiting whenever you are.
notifications.reminderDesc: When should we nudge you to check in? We'll skip days you've already checked in.
notifications.weekReviewBody: You showed up this week. Open the app to see your check-ins, mood arc, and boundaries held.
notifications.practiceDesc: Receive an occasional, clearly labeled practice call. Tap it, answer when ready, and the AI will open a realistic conversation.
notifications.practicePrivacy: Notifications never include names, family details, or conversation content. You can decline any call without penalty.
notifications.practicePermissionBody: Allow notifications for Sober Helpline in your device settings, then try again. Practice calls stay off until permission and token registration succeed.
notifications.practiceSaveErrorBody: We couldn't save that setting. Your previous setting is still active. Please try again.
notifications.practiceLoadError: We couldn't load your practice-call settings. Nothing was changed.

membership.premiumFeatures: Phone & video calls with a coach, business hours
membership.restoreNoneBody: We couldn't find any previous purchases for this Apple ID.
membership.restoreErrorBody: Something went wrong restoring your purchases. Please try again.

signOutErrorBody: We couldn't remove this device from private notifications. Check your connection and try again.

deleteAccount.confirmMessage: Your data will be permanently deleted within 30 days. This cannot be undone.
deleteAccount.errorMessage: We couldn't delete your account. You are still signed in and no deletion was completed. Please try again.
deleteAccount.cleanupErrorMessage: Your account was deleted, but this device couldn't finish signing out. Close and reopen the app to clear the old session.
